description: Disappearance-clock evidence for the adverse ledger. lastPublicAppearance is the last dated public appearance with an exact title before the first concrete sign of trouble; firstConcreteSignal is the earliest public, dated sign of trouble; formalAction is the formal Party, state, NPC or military disposition. Day counts are computed by the build script, never typed. Unknown is recorded as null, never inferred.

signalKinds.suspension_announced: Official announcement of suspension for investigation

Media context: VOA (2024-12-26) says rumours of his removal circulated from October 2024; Zaobao (2025-12-14) says he missed the 23 Dec 2024 promotion ceremony and other important occasions but attended the March 2025 NPC session while no longer Army commander (title at that time not verified; not an official naming with title); The Diplomat (2026-03-02) says he has been missing since the July 2025 PLA Day banquet (unverified). Plausible but unverified later appearances: Beijing Xiangshan Forum 12-14 Sep 2024 or other Sep-Dec 2024 Army events.
